visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a vibrant red and yellow background featuring a 2D graphic of a classic glass cola bottle filled with dark liquid. To the right, a significant pile of white crystalline powder, representing cocaine, is shown. A large red exclamation mark and question mark appear above the powder. The frame transitions to a monochrome manga panel showing a character wearing glasses with a shocked expression, with Japanese-style exclamation lines around his face. (2) A historical black-and-white portrait of John Pemberton, a man with a full beard and formal attire, is displayed centrally against a dark background. The scene transitions to a graphical representation of the formula: a pile of white powder and three red kola nuts are linked with a plus sign, leading to an image of a cola bottle labeled 'Original,' indicating the ingredients of the initial recipe. (3) Text-heavy frames define the etymology of the brand name. The word 'Cocaine' is shown above white powder, followed by 'Kola nut' above red seeds. An yellow 'excited' emoji with starry eyes appears next to the nuts. Then, 'Coca-Cola' is split, highlighting that 'Coca' comes from the drug and 'Cola' from the nut, accompanied by simplified icons of both components against a plain black background. (4) The focus shifts to an animated human avatar named 'Wei C,' a young male with black hair and a white T-shirt. He is shown with various expressions: initially holding papers and looking neutral, then appearing extremely worried with wide eyes and sweat drops as he contemplates the legality. The background remains a simple dark gradient with dynamic text overlays appearing to emphasize his speech. (5) The final section explores a fun fact regarding the Chinese translation. A cola bottle is shown again, with the bizarre text '蝌蚪啃蠟' in large yellow Chinese characters. The animated avatar reacts with a blue, melting 'shocked' face. The text then transitions to the modern '可口可樂' name with yellow sparkle effects, signaling the brand's successful rebranding.
